title: PWM generator: programmable period and duty, output and its complement
features: `DW`-bit (default 32) period and duty registers, written through the core register port.
Counter runs 0 .. PERIOD-1 and wraps; PERIOD = 0 stops it and holds the outputs low (`pwm_out` = 0, `pwm_n_out` = 1).
`pwm_out` is high while counter < DUTY; DUTY >= PERIOD gives 100 % duty, DUTY = 0 gives 0 %.
`pwm_n_out` is always the complement of `pwm_out` (no dead time).
Interrupt PERIOD_END once per period, in the last count (counter = PERIOD-1).

words.name: PERIOD
words.desc: Period in clocks (0 stops the output, held low)

words.name: DUTY
words.desc: Clocks per period the output is high

irqs.name: PERIOD_END
irqs.desc: the last clock of a period

notes: pwm_out and pwm_n_out are the outputs; they pass through unchanged. PERIOD and DUTY are write-only (the core has no readback): they read 0.
